# DaveHarness capabilities manifest

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_capabilities_manifest.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Generated from DaveLLM's tool registry by `scripts/generate_capabilities_manifest.py`. The same data is in [DAVEHARNESS_CAPABILITIES.json](DAVEHARNESS_CAPABILITIES.json). Do not edit either file: change the code, then run `python scripts/generate_capabilities_manifest.py`. Tests fail when the committed files are stale.

DaveLLM `2.1.0` · DaveHarness `1.0.0-rc.1` · manifest version 1

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Tools | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DAVE_ENABLE_TOOLS` | `false` | `file.append`, `file.read`, `file.write`, `system.info`, `web.fetch` | Turns on tool execution and the core tools. |
| `DAVE_ENABLE_SHELL_TOOL` | `false` | `shell.exec` | Registers shell.exec. Execution still needs DAVE_ENABLE_TOOLS. |
| `DAVE_ENABLE_EXTENDED_TOOLS` | `false` | `chat.search`, `cluster.status`, `file.edit`, `file.list`, `file.read_lines`, `file.search`, `git.diff`, `git.log`, `git.show`, `git.status`, `md.outline`, `md.section`, `project.artifacts`, `project.brain.read`, `project.notepad.read`, `web.read`, `web.search` | Registers the extended tools: bounded reads, web.search and web.read, plus file.edit, which needs approval for every call. ### notion.block.update

Change one block that notion.page.read returned in this run: replace old_text with new_text inside it, and/or check or uncheck a to-do. old_text must occur once and stay inside one formatting run, so the block keeps its formatting. To check or uncheck a to-do, also give block_text, the to-do's text. Nothing is sent if the block changed or moved since it was read. Needs the user's approval, which shows the text before and after or the to-do.

| Argument | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | string | yes | maxLength `40`, minLength `1` | The configured name of the Notion page, such as adapter-test; an unknown name lists the configured ones. |
| `block` | string | yes | maxLength `8`, minLength `2` | A block ref from notion.page.read in this run, such as b3. |
| `old_text` | string or null | no | maxLength `2000`, minLength `1` | The exact text to replace, copied from the block. |
| `new_text` | string or null | no | maxLength `2000` | The replacement text; empty deletes old_text. |
| `checked` | boolean or null | no | — | For a to-do: true checks it, false unchecks it. |
| `block_text` | string or null | no | maxLength `4000` | The block's whole text as notion.page.read showed it; required when only checked changes. |

## Runs

### Lifecycle run request

Body of `POST /tools/agent/runs`. Validators in `app.py` add checks not listed here, such as the number and size of `messages`.

| Field | Required | Default | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `messages` | yes | — | — |
| `node_id` | yes | — | max_length `128`, min_length `1` |
| `model` | yes | — | max_length `128`, min_length `1` |
| `project_id` | no | `null` | max_length `128` |
| `conversation_id` | no | `null` | max_length `128` |
| `max_tokens` | no | `2048` | ge `1`, le `262144` |
| `temperature` | no | `0.7` | ge `0`, le `2` |
| `step_limit` | no | `8` | ge `1`, le `32` |
| `error_budget` | no | `2` | ge `1`, le `8` |

### Decision request

Body of `POST /tools/agent/runs/{run_id}/decisions`.

| Field | Required | Default | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `call_id` | yes | — | max_length `256`, min_length `1` |
| `digest` | yes | — | pattern `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` |
| `definition_fingerprint` | yes | — | pattern `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` |
| `permission` | yes | — | max_length `80`, min_length `1` |
| `nonce` | yes | — | max_length `128`, min_length `1` |
| `decision` | yes | — | enum `["approve", "reject"]` |

### Run budget

Lifecycle runs start from these defaults, with `model_steps` and `errors` taken from the request's `step_limit` and `error_budget`. The legacy `/tools/agent/run` and `/tools/agent/resume` routes keep their original step and error limits only. `null` means no limit.

| Limit | Lifecycle runs | Legacy routes |
|---|---|---|
| `model_steps` | `8` | `8` |
| `errors` | `2` | `2` |
| `tool_calls` | `32` | `null` |
| `total_wall_seconds` | `300.0` | `null` |
| `tool_output_bytes` | `65536` | `null` |
| `transcript_bytes` | `2097152` | `null` |
| `event_count` | `1000` | `null` |

### Payload limits

DaveHarness's default ceiling for any JSON payload it admits.

| Limit | Value |
|---|---|
| `max_bytes` | `16777216` |
| `max_depth` | `32` |
| `max_nodes` | `100000` |

## Host limits

| Limit | Value |

## Routes

| Method | Path | Authentication | Endpoint |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/tools` | X-API-Key | `list_available_tools` |
| POST | `/tools/agent/resume` | X-API-Key | `resume_agent_endpoint` |
| POST | `/tools/agent/run` | X-API-Key | `run_agent_endpoint` |
| POST | `/tools/agent/runs` | X-API-Key | `create_agent_run` |
| GET | `/tools/agent/runs/{run_id}` | X-API-Key | `get_agent_run` |
| POST | `/tools/agent/runs/{run_id}/cancel` | X-API-Key | `cancel_agent_run` |
| POST | `/tools/agent/runs/{run_id}/decisions` | X-API-Key | `decide_agent_run` |
| GET | `/tools/agent/runs/{run_id}/events` | X-API-Key | `get_agent_run_events` |
| GET | `/tools/agent/runs/{run_id}/pending/notion-context` | X-API-Key | `notion_pending_context_route` |
| POST | `/tools/execute` | X-API-Key | `execute_tool_endpoint` |
